name: Ganeshotsav
text: Pune's defining public festival, with elaborate community pandals, processions and the famous 'manache' Ganpati order. Expect heavy crowds and road closures in the old city.

name: Pandharpur Wari / Palkhi
text: Pilgrim processions of Sant Dnyaneshwar and Sant Tukaram pass through Pune with devotees walking toward Pandharpur.

name: Sawai Gandharva Bhimsen Mahotsav
text: A major Hindustani classical music festival held in Pune over several nights.

name: Gudi Padwa
text: Marathi New Year, marked with gudi flags, rangoli and shobha yatra processions.

name: Diwali Pahat
text: Early-morning music concerts during Diwali, a long-running Pune tradition.

name: Puneri food culture
text: Misal pav, bakarwadi, mastani, Irani cafes and thali meals each have their own long-standing local institutions.
